decisions.reason: The zebra print's black border is a separate decision stated in the same message and is already represented; the basket-weave diamond scale and mustard edge do not change the zebra requirement.
Changing the basket-weave diamond scale and adding a fine mustard edge does not alter the production-readiness, CMYK, or seamless-repeat file requirements.
The mustard edge belongs specifically to the basket-weave design and does not change the independently defined mustard block-colour pareo.
The basket-weave scale and mustard edge do not change the terracotta block-colour pareo; its Pantone reference is a separate same-message decision already represented.

The existing colour-calibration requirement already governs visual approximation, final Pantone refinement, and ICC-profile handling; the basket-weave scale and mustard edge require no change to that state.
